newsitem.title: FRANCE: Five suspected cult members die in Canada-French TV.
newsitem.headline: Five suspected cult members die in Canada-French TV.

text.p: Five suspected members of a doomsday cult were found dead in a feared new group suicide or murder in a blaze in Canada, a French television station said on Sunday.

Independent news channel La Chaine Info (LCI), presenting what it said was an exclusive report, said the three women and two men were believed to be members or sympathisers of the Order of the Solar Temple.
Their corpses were found dead in a building gutted by a fire near Montreal on Saturday evening.

Fifty-three cult members died in a macabre ritual in 1994 in Switzerland and Canada, including guru Luc Jouret. Another 16 charred corpses were found in the French Alps in December 1995 in a grisly murder-cum-suicide.
French police had no immediate confirmation or comment on LCI's report.
LCI also said that three teenagers, aged 13, 14 and 16 were found lying down in a nearby building, apparently drugged. It said that they were now safe.

It said that their parents were believed to be linked to the sect and that cars belonging to sect members were found nearby. It said that Canadian investigators were focusing on the belief that the deaths were linked to the sect.
